items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Incidentally, Edmund thinks of me, sent me a card

ctx.x: What about Ben Thigpen? please. please.

Ben was with Andy Kirk, of course, beautiful man. He had a son Edmund... Incidentally, Edmund thinks of me, sent me a card I didn't know that Edmund was going to play drums, you see, until later on he took me out on a tennis court. I went to St. Louis before he went into the Army. I said, "Where's the best drummer in St. Louis?" And the boys in the car said, "You just took him home." I said, "Edmund plays drums? Ben's son?" Like father, like son. He never said nothing about drums; he never talked drums, to me.
Your son plays drums. Jonathan, Jr.
